name: Collier County, FL
findings: Collier County has 1,535 nonprofit organizations. 526 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 431 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Collier County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
